यूथं [यु-थक् पृषो˚ दीर्घः] A herd,
flock, multitude, a large number or
troop (as of beasts); स्त्रीरत्नेषु
ममोर्वशी प्रियतमा यूथे तवेयं वशा

.
--मुख्यः the chief of a troop or herd
(as of elephants &c.).

यूथ्य a. [यूथ-यत्]
1 Belonging to
a troop or herd (at the end of
comp.), as in श्वयूथ्याः.
--2 Belonging
to a herd or flock, being at the head
of a herd.

यूथिका, --यूथी A kind of
jasmine or its flower; यूथिकाशवलकेशी
